<function name="GetAmmoID" parent="game" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>
Returns the ammo type ID for given ammo type name.

See <page>game.GetAmmoName</page> for reverse.
	</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="name" type="string">Name of the ammo type to look up ID of.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">The ammo type ID of given ammo type name, or -1 if not found.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
